newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine earthquake said moderate, no damage.
newsitem.headline: Philippine earthquake said moderate, no damage.

text.p: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology said on Friday it had recorded a moderate earthquake in the south of the country but did not expect any damage to be reported.
"We don't expect any damage report ... We don't expect any tsunamis (tidal wave) either," a government seismologist told Reuters.

She said the quake, which measured 5.9 on the Richter scale, had a shallow tectonic origin and occurred at 8.43 a.m. (0043 GMT). The Royal Hong Kong Observatory earlier said it measured the quake at 6.2 on the Richter scale.
The quake was centred in the sea 149 km (90 miles) east of Surigao, a city on the main southern island of Mindanao some 730 km (450 miles) south of Manila.
The Philippines frequently experiences earthquakes, most of which cause little or no damage.
